name: Penny Pelican

features.name: Multiplier wilds
features.description: Wilds on reels 2–4 carry 2x or 3x multipliers that add up.

features.name: Bonus trigger
features.description: Three bonus symbols on reels 1, 3 and 5 start free spins.

review:
Penny Pelican is a 20-line treasure-hunting slot. The wild appears only on reels 2, 3 and 4 and carries a random 2x or 3x multiplier that applies to every line it's part of. If several wilds join the same win, their multipliers are added.

Three bonus symbols on reels 1, 3 and 5 trigger free spins, with something determined before the round starts. A bonus buy is available where permitted. BGaming rates it very high volatility with a 3,525x maximum and a 95.98% RTP. Free spins arrive about once every 177 spins. A light-hearted theme for a high-variance game.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Very high volatility – long dry spells are normal
Bonus buy is costly and banned in some markets (e.g. Great Britain)
